test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All remotes are infrared.

2. All infrared are gamma.

**Conclusions:**

1. All gamma are remote

2. Some gamma are remote.

3. No remote are gamma

4. Some remote are not infrared.
solution:
**Explanation:**

The least possible Venn diagram of the given statement will be :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d5236439d21e14fb1599f0befb0f99c39f892085c0de0a2dbb5952d7d83cf1c.png] 

Conclusion 1.All gamma are remote [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False ( All gamma are not remote as shown in the above)

Conclusion 2.Some gamma are remote. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] True ( as some gamma are remote given in the above statement)

Conclusion 3.No remote are gamma [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False ( because there is not any direct relation between remote and gamma)

Conclusion 4.Some remote are not infrared. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False (as shown above)

**Hence, Only conclusion 2 follows is the correct answer.**
